name: token-todo
description: A user-invoked Codex skill for converting eligible, time-bounded coding capacity into safe, reviewable engineering progress.

interface.shortDescription: Turn eligible expiring capacity into safe engineering progress
interface.longDescription: Plan and execute bounded project maintenance from a user-stated resource and time envelope. Token Todo uses explicit approval, conservative estimates, small checkpoints, verification, and rollback; it does not inspect account quotas or run background monitoring.
defaultPrompt: Use Token Todo to plan a bounded, reversible maintenance sprint from a user-stated resource and time budget.
Use Token Todo to curate this project's low-risk backlog without reading account quota data.
